title: Empirical Multi-Domain Generalization & Model Adaptation Report
description: Zero-leakage pilot benchmark across 17 held-out documents spanning 6 functional domains (21,495 split tokens, 21,210 evaluated causal targets). Discloses measured regressions alongside cross-domain improvements.

adapted_metadata.fine_tuning: 5 Epochs AdamW (LR 1e-4, weight_decay 0.01, grad_clip 1.0) on multi-domain pilot
adapted_metadata.vocabulary: Preserved 30,000-token word vocabulary (100% backward and inference compatible)

full_test_baseline_reference.notes: Authoritative evaluation of frozen best_val.pt on complete 7.93M token test split.

token_weighted_summary.description: Aggregate evaluation across all 21,210 causal targets across 17 test documents in 6 domains (technical_docs contributes 8,960 targets, wikitext 4,585, etc.).

macro_average_summary.description: Equal-weight unweighted arithmetic mean across all 6 evaluated domains, preventing document size imbalance from dominating the metric.

baseline.description: Equal-weight unweighted arithmetic mean across all 6 evaluated domains

adapted.description: Equal-weight unweighted arithmetic mean across all 6 evaluated domains

deltas.description: Measured regression on the original source domain (+0.0458 loss, +2.38 PPL, -0.50% Top-1, -0.54% Top-5) reflecting the empirical plasticity-stability trade-off during out-of-domain adaptation.

deltas.notes: Perplexity improved by -9.68 and Top-5 by +0.41%, but Top-1 accuracy had a slight measured regression of -0.21%.
Measured in-domain regression (+0.0328 loss, +1.63 PPL, -0.11% Top-1, -0.55% Top-5) due to parameter adaptation toward out-of-domain text.

metric_limitations.word_level_oov: Fixed 30,000 word-level vocabulary replaces unknown words with <unk>. In technical/news domains, OOV rate ranges from 5.3% to 6.7%, masking true semantic prediction quality on named entities.
metric_limitations.perplexity_interpretation: Perplexity is vocabulary-dependent: PPL=40 on a 30k vocabulary means effective uncertainty across 40 words out of 30,000. It cannot be directly compared against byte/subword models.
metric_limitations.top1_vs_top5: In natural language, multiple valid completions exist. Top-1 penalizes equally valid synonyms, making Top-5 (57.1% on adapted) a more realistic proxy for language comprehension.
metric_limitations.qualitative_heuristics: Plausible surface syntax can hide factual hallucinations or local repetition loops. Evaluation must combine automated cross-entropy with human audit.
metric_limitations.pilot_scope: The multi-domain benchmark comprises 17 documents (21,495 tokens). While statistically sound and strictly leak-free, it is a pilot benchmark and does not imply universal open-ended generalization across uncurated corpora.
